My priorities
## Ask practical questions. Informed leadership.
01Academic excellence for all
Kindergarten–third grade results show mixed progress, with declines in first-grade reading and math.
First grade: at or above grade level · 2024 → 2026
Reading: 76.9% → 69.9% · Math: 70.2% → 60.9%
College readiness: Graduates completing UC/CSU-required A–G coursework declined from 2024 to 2025: 55.9% → 51.6%.
Advocate for strong foundations and equitable access, especially for student groups facing achievement gaps. Prioritize early intervention, tutoring, progress checks, college and career planning, and college and business partnerships.
Source: MUSD 2026–27 LCAP, pp. 15–16, 18. Reported results; student cohorts may differ.
02Thoughtful AI use / Digital safety
Emphasize learning over simply producing answers.
Advocate for hands-on elementary learning, age-appropriate screen-time limits and intentional AI use in higher grades.
Support practical AI literacy for families, covering AI’s benefits, limitations, biases and misinformation.
03Safe schools / Student privacy
Advocate for safe campuses, digital safety and clear rules on student data collection, access and use—with transparent tool approval and regular public reviews.
04Family partnerships
Listen, collaborate and communicate openly with families and educators.
05Support educators / More time to teach
Support and retain excellent educators. Advocate for carefully reviewed tools that reduce paperwork, support planning and help identify learning needs.
### My experience. Your voice.
As an MUSD parent, technology professional with 20+ years of experience, Milpitas City Commissioner and an educational nonprofit Cultural Officer, I bring a family’s perspective, analytical thinking and collaborative problem-solving.
Community involvement
## Volunteering for students, schools and the wider community
My hands-on service includes environmental and cultural education, youth robotics, and sustained involvement across Milpitas schools.
Environmental education & awareness
### Creating awareness through community activities
As a Milpitas Environmental and Sustainability Commissioner, I promote environmental education and awareness through Earth Day programs, film screenings and Go Electric Milpitas outreach. These activities help residents learn about clean energy, electrification and ways to build a more sustainable Milpitas.
Photos +
Language & cultural education
### Cultural Officer at Nonprofit Language School (ITA) — Serving 300+ students
ITA teaches Tamil language and culture through year-round weekend classes serving 300+ students. As Cultural Officer, I help organize festival celebrations and the annual year-end program, where students showcase dance, drama, singing and other talents through a variety of performances.
Photos +
STEM education & youth leadership
### Guiding a middle school robotics team
My husband and I formed a middle school FIRST LEGO League team, taught and trained the students, and led the team through the full competition season. The team earned first place for programming at the Northern California East Bay District championship and was also recognized for robot design.
Photos +
School community
### Milpitas School and Community Involvement
View school and community photosClose school and community photos+
School leadershipRancho Middle School · CBAC RepresentativeExplore my involvementClose details+
For two years, I served as Rancho's Community Board Advisory Committee representative to MUSD and participated on the School Site Council. In council meetings, the SPSA, school calendar, plans and goals are reviewed and developed collectively. I contribute to these discussions, participate in planning and report school activities at MUSD Board meetings.
Fundraising leadershipMilpitas High School · PTSA Fundraising ChairExplore my involvementClose details+
For two years, I served as PTSA Fundraising Chair. I set up Benevity, encouraged donors to maximize their contributions through employer matching, and raised funds through Bingo events.
School accountabilityPomeroy Elementary SchoolExplore my involvementClose details+
I served on the School Site Council and as an auditor, reviewing school spending to support responsible and transparent use of funds.
Elementary school & youth serviceLincoln Elementary School & Cub Scout Pack 413Explore my involvementClose details+
Throughout my youngest son's six years at Lincoln Elementary, I volunteered as a classroom parent, chaperone and event volunteer, including supporting the science fair. I also organized Pack 413's year-end graduation ceremony, dinner and community potluck to celebrate the Cub Scouts and bring families together.
Alumni service25th Anniversary Reunion Core CommitteeExplore my involvementClose details+
I served on the core committee for the 25th anniversary reunion of Alagappa Chettiar Government College of Engineering and Technology, Karaikudi, helping coordinate the milestone gathering and support our alumni community's shared goals.
Why I'm running
## Education changed my life. Service is how I give back.
As an MUSD parent and technology professional with more than 20 years of experience, I bring a family's perspective, analytical thinking and collaborative problem-solving. I am running to expand opportunity for every student, support educators and strengthen public education in the community I call home.
Anuradha Sankaran
